corrections.reason: The printed glyph in 'ኀቤሁ' is 4th-order 'ኀ' (rabi), not 5th-order 'ኅ' (hamis), matching standard Ge'ez morphology 'ኀቤሁ'.

In Ge'ez accusative following 'ርእዮ ለሌዊ', 'መጸብሐዌ' has the 5th-order 'ዌ' (with bottom right ring) on the page. Also, at the end of line 7 only 'አ' (or 'እ') is printed, while 'ንዘ' is at the start of line 8.
Line 8 begins with 'ንዘ' completing 'እንዘ' from the end of line 7.
The prefix 'የ' at the end of line 6 wraps onto 'ፈሪሳውያን' on line 7 to form 'የፈሪሳውያን'.
The glyph has the 2nd-order vowel stroke on the right ('ፉ'), reading 'ቢሰፉት' ('if they sew it'), matching standard Amharic Andemta grammar.
